name: Papercut Art
author: TBIT DESIGN - Thomas Breher
description: Layered papercut scenes with real depth - the lightbox look, computed entirely in your browser. A scene is a stack of complete paper SHEETS, and everything you place on them stays an OBJECT: click it in the picture, drag it where you want it, turn it (Alt-drag or the rotation slider - standing things pivot on their feet and stay on the ground), resize it, roll a new variation, send it to the sheet behind or in front, or delete it. Nothing is ever baked in. Each new element brings its own full sheet with it - a horizon at its feet with soft mounds carrying it, or a backdrop with the shape punched out - so what you compose is always a real, cuttable stack. Place parametric landscapes that reroll with every seed (alpine ridges, rolling hills, dunes, scalloped water, a city skyline with setbacks and spires), procedural forests (conifers, broadleaf, birches, palms, shrubs), patches of grass, reeds, meadow flowers and boulders, cumulus clouds, a sun, a full moon or a crescent, corner branches with leaves, your own words as paper or cut letters, and TWENTY-THREE animal silhouettes traced from PUBLIC-DOMAIN originals - deer, moose, fox, hare, bear, wolf, cat, dog, owl, horse, squirrel, boar, ibex, robin, gull, whale and dolphin on the ground, plus soaring eagle, heron, gulls, songbirds, owl and butterfly in the sky. Or start from a PHOTO: the picture is sliced into depth sheets along its brightness, with draggable band handles on a live histogram, and the LOCAL subject cutout lifts a person or product onto the front sheet, nothing uploaded anywhere. Every sheet passes the CUTTABILITY ENGINE: contours are smoothed into scissor-true curves, features respect a minimum bridge width in real millimeters for your chosen physical size, floating pieces get automatic stencil bridges, and each sheet is PROVEN to be one connected piece of paper. Sixteen ready scenes to start from, eight looks from all-white lightbox over sunset and forest to night glow, brand kit colours, six frames (circle, heart, arch, oval, hexagon, initial letter), and one shared light you drag to set every shadow. Insert as a group of editable layers - one per sheet - export the CUT PACKAGE with one clean SVG per sheet for cutting machines, or record a reveal video where the scene assembles sheet by sheet.
